articles.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.snippet: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.

articles.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had third alleged affair: Reuters
articles.snippet: Reuters reported that Jensen Huang had a relationship with another Nvidia employee, hours after he resigned as CEO.

articles.title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia’s CEO
articles.snippet: In a matter of days, the executive synonymous with the AI boom resigned after 33 years amid reports of affairs and suspected Chinese intelligence ties—sending Nvidia’s stock reeling and leaving the chipmaker leaderless.

articles.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
articles.snippet: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.
